build_scale_features: build a pipeline that standardizes features using StandardScaler with mean 0 and standard deviation 1
train_knn_scaled: train a KNeighborsClassifier on scaled and unscaled data to compare decision boundaries
apply_pca_scaling: apply PCA on scaled and unscaled data to compare principal component weights
visualize_decision_boundary: visualize decision boundaries of a classifier using DecisionBoundaryDisplay with scatter plot overlay
evaluate_logistic_regression: evaluate LogisticRegressionCV with cross-validated C on scaled versus unscaled PCA-reduced data
